name: Tree
summary: Displays a nested selectable and expandable collection.

useWhen: Browsing or opening items in a nested hierarchy, such as files
avoidWhen: Displaying a flat option list; use ListBox
Moving between the pages of an app; use Sidebar

obligations: Expose tree, level, expanded, and item semantics.
Expose selection, disabled, and empty state.

behavior: Arrow keys navigate and expand nested items.
Selection is either controlled by the application or managed by the component.
Row expansion is enabled by default: clicking or tapping a parent label or row space expands or collapses it, while setting expansionTrigger to chevron keeps expansion on the chevron control.

With onAction set and selectionMode multiple, a click or Enter on an item runs the action while nothing is selected, so pointer users start a selection with Space or a selection affordance in the item content.
Items nest through children, and selectedIds and expandedIds list item ids.
Give every item an id that is unique across the whole tree, not only among its siblings, and stable when the data changes.
An item without an id takes its key, value, or its position among its siblings as its id.
A repeated id gets a numeric suffix in tree order.
A disabled item disables all of its descendants.
A click on a parent row runs onAction in either mode. With row expansion it also expands or collapses the row; with chevron expansion only the chevron does.
accessibility: Expose tree, level, expanded, and item semantics.
Expose selection, disabled, and empty state.
